Language

GitHub search needs an internet connection — it queries the public GitHub API directly from your browser. Unauthenticated requests are rate-limited to ~10/min.

About

Two tools here: turn any file or text into a data:/blob: link, or run text/code through a conversion (Base64, JSON, case, etc.) — search or pick a chip below to find one.

Notes

Everything runs locally in your browser, fully offline — nothing is uploaded. The data:/blob: tool accepts any file, including images. Every other conversion reads its input as text, so it's meant for code, markup, and plain text rather than binary files.

File / Text → data: & blob: quick convert

Drop any file — images included — or paste text/code. HTML is auto-detected and turned into a link that actually runs as a page when opened, not just downloaded as text.

Drop a file here, or click to browse
(images, code, text — anything)
— or —
 
— or —

Scratch (.sb3) → HTML TurboWarp Packager

Runs the real, official TurboWarp Packager, fully offline. Spacepad doesn't fetch it from turbowarp.org or anywhere else — you load a local copy once below, and everything after that happens entirely in your browser.

One-time setup: grab turbowarp-packager-standalone-*.html from the Assets of TurboWarp's latest GitHub release (TurboWarp/packager → Releases). That single file is the whole packager — nothing else to install, and it never has to touch a server again after you download it.
Drop turbowarp-packager-standalone-*.html here, or click to browse

Text & code conversions

Search or pick a conversion, then paste text/code or drop a file.

Drop a file here, or click to browse (read as text)
— or —

Encrypt / Decrypt AES-256-GCM

Password-based encryption using the Web Crypto API — PBKDF2 derives the key from your passphrase, and AES-GCM encrypts with a random salt and IV each time, bundled into the output so only the passphrase is needed to decrypt.

Run from URL HTML / Python

Paste a link to a raw HTML or Python file — a jsDelivr link (cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/user/repo@branch/file), a GitHub raw link, or any URL that allows cross-origin requests. Spacepad fetches it, figures out which kind of file it is, and runs it: HTML opens live in a new tab, Python runs right here using the same runtime as the Python tab.

About

A grab-bag of small dev utilities — link converters, generators, and text tools that don't need a whole tab of their own.

Notes

Everything here runs locally in your browser, fully offline — nothing is uploaded, except the GitHub→jsDelivr tool's optional "Fetch & Run", which needs a real network request to actually fetch the file.
No tools match that search.

Website viewer

Type or paste any link and it loads live below, in an embedded frame. Some sites (banks, Google, most social apps) block being shown inside another page and will stay blank here — use "Open in new tab" for those instead.

 

GitHub → jsDelivr CDN link

Paste a GitHub file or repo URL (a blob link, a raw.githubusercontent.com link, or just user/repo) and get back a fast, cached jsDelivr CDN link for it.

 

Sticky notes

Little draggable notes that float over the whole app. Click "Add note" then drag onto the page to place one (or just click, to drop it centered); right-click a note to recolor or delete it.

 

Quick Open any file

Drop or choose any file and it opens right away in a new tab: HTML, SVG, text, Markdown, JSON, images, audio, video and PDF are shown by the browser from a Blob with the right type. Or paste text below. Pick the method (shared with Settings), then use Send to Editor to edit it.

Drop any file here, or click to choose one
or paste text
 

Quick launch no preview

Drop a file or browse for one and it launches immediately in a new tab — no extra click. Paste code instead if you'd rather (pasted text is masked as you type, and launching then is one click away). Re-open the same code as blob: or about:blank any time; the code itself is never shown on screen, only its size.

Drop an .html file here, or click to browse
— or —
 

Password / passphrase generator

Generated with the Web Crypto API's real random-number source — nothing here is stored or sent anywhere.

Convert an integer between binary, octal, decimal, hex, or any base from 2–36.

Paste a 5-field cron expression to see it in plain English, plus its next few run times (based on your browser's clock).

URL parser & builder

Snippet library

Common boilerplate — search, preview, and insert straight into the Editor tab's HTML/CSS/JS pane at your cursor.

Settings

Spacepad stores nothing in your browser. Everything lasts for this visit only; it carries into new tabs you open from here, and you can keep it with Export everything under Backup. Nothing is sent anywhere.

General

Ask before closing the tab
Shows your browser's "Leave site?" prompt when you close, reload or navigate away, since nothing is saved. Browsers show their own generic message.
Screen to open on load
Which screen Spacepad shows when it starts (including after an import).
Auto-lock when idle
Show the lock screen after this long without activity. Your windows and work stay exactly as they are.
Open in new tab using
The one method used by every "open in a new tab" button.
Command palette
Keyboard shortcuts

Appearance

Theme
Night or Day.
Performance mode
Freezes the starfield, planets and ambient meteors and trims blurs and glows, so Spacepad runs smoother on slower computers. Effects you trigger still play. Turns on automatically on low-power devices until you choose.
Reduce motion
Stops the drifting background and button-press animation.
Ambient meteors & comets
The shooting stars that drift across the background.
Cosmic effects
Master switch for the Effects menu (solar flares, aurora surges, supernovas…). Off disables all of them.
Play a random effect every few minutes
Same as "Auto-play" in the Effects menu.

Windows & Apps

Backup

Export everything
Downloads one JSON file with your apps, sticky notes, editor and Python code, settings, layout and theme. Chat API keys are never included.
Import everything
Loads a Spacepad backup and replaces everything in this session. Spacepad restarts with the imported state.
Or paste backup JSON
Reset everything
Wipes this session (apps, notes, code, settings) and restarts Spacepad blank.

Customize

Personalize the Spacepad desktop and shell. Changes last for this visit; use Settings → Backup to keep them. Want more control? The Wallpapers, Appearance, Widgets, Icon Layout, Custom CSS, Shortcuts and Window Layouts apps go further, and share these same settings.

Your apps

Build your own app from HTML, Python code, or a web page, and it shows up as an icon on the Desktop.

Hidden desktop icons

Import & export apps

Each app exports in its own file type: HTML apps as .html, Python as .py, SVG as .svg, Markdown / text as .md / .txt, and web-page, GitHub and store apps as a .json descriptor. Export all saves every app in one .spacepad.json bundle. Import takes any of those (plus plain .url shortcuts) from the button below or by dropping files anywhere on this window.

Drop app files here, or click to choose (.html .svg .md .txt .py .url .json)

    Only import files you trust: imported HTML, Python and web-page apps run like apps you write yourself. Files up to 5 MB, 200 apps per bundle.

    Import by link

    Paste a jsDelivr (or other) link to a spacepad-apps.json file. Only import from sources you trust — imported apps can run arbitrary code.

    App Store

    Extra mini-apps and games — click Install and they show up on the Desktop like any other app. Everything here is self-contained and works offline, except MyArcade.Win, which loads live from jsDelivr. Use Remove to take one off your desktop again. Cards tagged Built in are small tools that ship with Spacepad: Install shows their desktop icon, Remove only hides it, and they stay reachable from Accessories and Ctrl+K.

    My Apps

    Add your own app (HTML, Python, a URL, or a GitHub repo), plus export and import apps as files (.html, .svg, .md, .json and more) or by link.
